sourcePolicy: Final integration records bind approved core, reference, slideshow, full-view and normalization artifacts to a runtime projection without changing mathematical meaning or compressing approved learning beats.
rules: All five approved artifact layers must be present and version-locked.
Runtime projection must satisfy the active E129 importer contract.
Merge mode must use lessonId and must not replace the complete content store.
Sixteen E129 roles are a preferred baseline, not a maximum slide count.
A user requirement of minimum 16 slides must not be rewritten as exactly 16 slides.
Every approved slideshow learning beat must remain represented unless an explicit later editorial decision removes it.
Automatic binding must not mutate localStorage or rewrite a monolithic content file without preserving all records.
Browser verification is required after explicit runtime import or durable merge.
Reader Pro, E235 and UI layout remain unchanged during integration.
